title: MineHud
description: MineHud: This mod allows you to see the number of days, coordinates and biome you are in.
body:
## MiniHud

This is a Hud that can help you in different situations.

## What can this mod do?

It allows you to:

1. **See how many days have passed in your world.**
2. **View your coordinates.**
3. **See the biome you are in**
